text: Bitdefender is a cybersecurity company co-founded by its CEO, Florin Talpeș, and his wife Mariuca. When Vitruvian Partners bought a stake of about 30% from Axxess Capital in December 2017, Bitdefender said Vitruvian became its second-largest shareholder and the co-founders continued to hold the majority stake.
short: Bitdefender's co-founders, CEO Florin Talpeș and Mariuca Talpeș, held the majority stake (2017).

source.name: Bitdefender – Bitdefender Announces Investment from Growth Capital Investor Vitruvian Partners (press release, PR Newswire)
source.quote: Following the acquisition, Vitruvian becomes the second-largest shareholder with co-founders Mariuca and Florin Talpes continuing to hold the majority stake.

additionalSources.name: Bitdefender – Leadership
additionalSources.quote: Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer, Florin Talpes is a visionary technology entrepreneur who together with his wife Mariuca, founded one of the first private software companies in post-communist Romania that grew to become Bitdefender.
